mechanics_summary: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super counter/teleport technique. The user adopts the Instant Transmission pose; if struck by a basic, Strike, or Ki Blast attack before teleporting, the user appears behind the attacker and fires a red Ki blast. If nothing triggers the counter, the teleport still occurs and consumes Ki without firing. The teleport/follow-up cannot be canceled into another Super, leaving a punishable recovery window. Current documentation treats it as an all-attack counter and evasive repositioning option; exact counter-active timing, damage, and frame data remain unresolved.
